# Code page conversion vectors: capture_win32.c runs them on Windows, crt_tests
# replays them against the runtime (runtime/tests/data/codepages_windows.tsv).
#   m2w <cp> <flags hex> <source hex|-> <cbMultiByte> <cchWideChar>
#   w2m <cp> <flags hex> <UTF-16LE source hex|-> <cchWideChar> <cbMultiByte> <lpDefaultChar hex|-> <ask lpUsedDefaultChar 0/1>
# Code pages: 0 CP_ACP, 1 CP_OEMCP, 2 CP_MACCP, 3 CP_THREAD_ACP, 42 CP_SYMBOL,
# 65000 UTF-7, 65001 UTF-8. Flags: MB_PRECOMPOSED 1, MB_COMPOSITE 2,
# MB_USEGLYPHCHARS 4, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS 8; WC_DISCARDNS 10, WC_SEPCHARS 20,
# WC_DEFAULTCHAR 40, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS 80, WC_COMPOSITECHECK 200,
# WC_NO_BEST_FIT_CHARS 400.
